name: Perizzites
overview: The Perizzites were one of the seven nations inhabiting the land of Canaan during the time of Abraham and the Exodus, as noted alongside the Canaanites, Hittites, and others (Genesis 13:7; Exodus 3:8). God commanded the Israelites to utterly destroy these peoples, including the Perizzites, as part of His judgment and the fulfillment of His promise to give the land to Abraham's descendants (Exodus 23:23; Deuteronomy 20:17). Despite this divine mandate, Scripture records that the Israelites dwelt among the Perizzites and intermarried with them, indicating that not all were destroyed (Judges 3:5). This tension highlights the ongoing challenge of holiness and separation for God's people in a fallen world.
